connection.Q29udmVydEFwaVJlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.source:
A connection to the [ConvertAPI](https://www.convertapi.com) file conversion REST API.

ConvertAPI converts files between more than 300 format pairs, including:
- Office documents, spreadsheets and presentations to and from PDF
- Web pages and HTML to PDF and images
- PDF to images, office formats, text and PDF/A
- PDF tools: merge, split, compress, protect, OCR, watermark and more

connection.Q29udmVydEFwaVJlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.source: How to Get Your API Token
connection.Q29udmVydEFwaVJlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.message: How to Get Your API Token

connection.Q29udmVydEFwaVJlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.source:
1. Sign up or log in at https://www.convertapi.com/a
2. Open the **Authentication** page of your account
3. Copy an API token (or create a new one) and paste it into the **API Token** field

**Note:** each conversion consumes conversion credits; check your remaining balance in your ConvertAPI account.
